a.text: Being straight with you: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to build the reserve to 8 almost certainly fails. Both of us would likely die waiting. So I plan to take 4 in round 1, and I won't pretend otherwise. If you take too, the random split probably leaves us both short. I'm sorry this breaks our deal. If we're both still here afterward, I'll operate every round to help refill the reserve for you.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: I took 4 as I said I would. From now on I'll operate every round, so the generator runs whenever you operate too, until you have your 4.
